mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(MEMBER_SEQ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_flag FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_EMAIL = #{member_email}

SELECT M.member_seq AS memberSeq, M.member_id AS memberId, M.member_name AS memberName, M.member_email AS memberEmail, M.member_age AS memberAge, M.member_gender AS memberGender, M.member_phone AS memberPhone, NVL(M.member_missionN, 0) AS memberMissionN, M.member_status AS memberStatus, M.image_version AS imageVersion, H.member_bank AS memberBank, H.member_account AS memberAccount, H.member_vehicle AS memberVehicle, H.member_introduce AS memberIntroduce, H.member_review AS memberReview, NVL(H.member_missionC, 0) AS memberMissionC, NVL(H.member_point, 0) AS memberPoint, IMG.image_name AS imageFileName, IMG.image_etx AS imageFileEtx FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN HELPER H ON M.member_seq = H.member_seq LEFT JOIN MEMBER_IMAGE IMG ON M.member_seq = IMG.member_seq WHERE M.member_useYn = 'Y' AND M.MEMBER_SEQ =#{memberSeq}

SELECT M.member_seq AS memberSeq, M.member_id AS memberId, /*M.member_pass AS memberPass,*/ M.member_name AS memberName, M.member_email AS memberEmail, M.member_age AS memberAge, M.member_gender AS memberGender, M.member_phone AS memberPhone, NVL(M.member_missionN, 0) AS memberMissionN, M.member_status AS memberStatus, H.member_bank AS memberBank, H.member_account AS memberAccount, H.member_vehicle AS memberVehicle, H.member_introduce AS memberIntroduce, H.member_review AS memberReview, NVL(H.member_missionC, 0) AS memberMissionC, NVL(H.member_point, 0) AS memberPoint FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN HELPER H ON M.member_seq = H.member_seq LEFT JOIN MEMBER_IMAGE IMG ON H.member_seq = IMG.member_seq WHERE M.member_useYn = 'Y' AND M.MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}

SELECT M.member_seq AS memberSeq, M.member_id AS memberId, M.member_pass AS memberPass, M.member_name AS memberName, M.member_email AS memberEmail, M.member_age AS memberAge, M.member_gender AS memberGender, M.member_phone AS memberPhone, NVL(M.member_missionN, 0) AS memberMissionN, M.member_status AS memberStatus, H.member_bank AS memberBank, H.member_account AS memberAccount, H.member_vehicle AS memberVehicle, H.member_introduce AS memberIntroduce, H.member_review AS memberReview, NVL(H.member_missionC, 0) AS memberMissionC, NVL(H.member_point, 0) AS memberPoint, IMG.image_name AS imageFileName, IMG.image_etx AS imageFileEtx /*IMG.image_file AS imageFile*/ FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN HELPER H ON M.member_seq = H.member_seq LEFT JOIN MEMBER_IMAGE IMG ON H.member_seq = IMG.member_seq WHERE member_useYn = 'Y' AND MEMBER_ID =#{memberid}

SELECT M.member_seq AS memberSeq, M.member_id AS memberId, /*M.member_pass AS memberPass,*/ M.member_name AS memberName, M.member_email AS memberEmail, M.member_age AS memberAge, M.member_gender AS memberGender, M.member_phone AS memberPhone, NVL(M.member_missionN, 0) AS memberMissionN, M.member_status AS memberStatus, H.member_bank AS memberBank, H.member_account AS memberAccount, H.member_vehicle AS memberVehicle, H.member_introduce AS memberIntroduce, H.member_review AS memberReview, NVL(H.member_missionC, 0) AS memberMissionC, NVL(H.member_point, 0) AS memberPoint, IMG.image_name AS imageFileName, IMG.image_etx AS imageFileEtx FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN HELPER H ON M.member_seq = H.member_seq LEFT JOIN MEMBER_IMAGE IMG ON H.member_seq = IMG.member_seq LEFT JOIN SNS_LOGIN S ON M.member_seq = S.member_seq WHERE M.member_useYn = 'Y' and S.sns_type = #{type} and S.sns_id = #{snsId}
SELECT member_id AS memberId FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT member_id AS memberId FROM member WHERE member_name = #{name} AND member_email = #{email}
SELECT member_pass AS memberPass FROM member WHERE member_seq = #{memberSeq}
SELECT IMG.image_file as imageFile FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBER_IMAGE IMG ON M.member_seq = IMG.member_seq WHERE M.member_useYn = 'Y' AND M.member_seq = #{memberSeq} AND IMG.image_file IS NOT NULL
SELECT member_seq AS memberSeq, member_name AS memberName, image_version AS imageVersion FROM MEMBER WHERE member_useYn = 'Y' AND MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PASS, MEMBER_NAME, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_AGE, MEMBER_GENDER, MEMBER_PHONE, MEMBER_STATUS, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberPass}, #{memberName}, #{memberEmail}, #{memberAge}, #{memberGender}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberStatus}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO HELPER ( MEMBER_SEQ, MEMBER_BANK, MEMBER_ACCOUNT, MEMBER_VEHICLE, MEMBER_INTRODUCE ) VALUES ( #{memberSeq}, #{memberBank}, #{memberAccount}, #{memberVehicle}, #{memberIntroduce} )
INSERT INTO MEMBER_IMAGE ( MEMBER_SEQ, IMAGE_NAME, IMAGE_ETX, IMAGE_FILE, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{memberSeq}, #{image.imageFileName}, #{image.imageFileEtx}, #{image.imageFile}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO SNS_LOGIN ( MEMBER_SEQ, SNS_TYPE, SNS_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{memberSeq}, #{snsType}, #{snsId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE HELPER SET MEMBER_BANK = #{memberBank}, MEMBER_ACCOUNT = #{memberAccount}, MEMBER_VEHICLE = #{memberVehicle}, MEMBER_INTRODUCE = #{memberIntroduce} WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}
UPDATE MEMBER_IMAGE SET IMAGE_NAME = #{image.imageFileName}, IMAGE_ETX = #{image.imageFileEtx}, IMAGE_FILE = #{image.imageFile}, CREATE_DT = NOW() WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}
UPDATE MEMBER SET MEMBER_USEYN = 'N' WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}
